blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Police arrested two suspects following a shooting incident in Sitio Haguines, Barangay Wasig in Mansalay town, on Saturday afternoon. The Mansalay Municipal Police Station launched a hot-pursuit operation after receiving a report of the shooting at around 5:30 p.m., police said. Responding police officers proceeded to the Oriental Mindoro Southern District Hospital to verify the report and check on the victim’s condition before tracking down the suspects.
